question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Submissive
solution:
The correct answer is 'Obedient'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Submissive is an adjective which means ready to conform to the authority or will of others; meekly obedient or passive.
 
• The meaning of the given options are as follows - 
 
 
• Adamant - refusing to be persuaded or to change one's mind.
 
• Obdurate - stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion or course of action.
 
• Obedient - complying or willing to comply with an order or request; submissive to another's authority.
 
• Obstinate - stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion or chosen course of action, despite attempts to persuade one to do so.
 
 
 
• From the above meanings it is evident that obedient is the correct synonym for the word submissive.
 
• Hence, option 3 is the correct answer.
